carregarQuery:
=SELECT c.id, c.code, c.name, c.group_name, c.test_type, c.category_name, c.subcategory_name,
  c.expected_document_id, c.expected_document_ids, c.question, c.expected_answer,
  c.required_words, c.forbidden_words, c.required_source_document_id, c.min_score,
  c.expect_no_answer, c.notes, c.status, c.version, c.depends_on_missing_docs,
  '{{ $json.runId }}'::text AS run_id,
  '{{ String($json.authorization || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS authorization,
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.promptVersion || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    CASE WHEN pv.id IS NOT NULL THEN pv.prompt_code || '@v' || pv.version_number || ':' || substring(pv.content_hash from 1 for 12) END,
    (SELECT value FROM app_secrets WHERE key='ai_eval_prompt_version' LIMIT 1),
    'unknown'
  ) AS prompt_version,
  pv.id AS prompt_version_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ String($json.modelName || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''), (SELECT value FROM app_secrets WHERE key='ai_eval_model_name' LIMIT 1), 'unknown') AS model_name,
  COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ String($json.refusalPhrase || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''), (SELECT value FROM app_secrets WHERE key='ai_eval_refusal_phrase' LIMIT 1), 'Não encontrei essa informação na base documental disponível.') AS refusal_phrase,
  COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $json.maxLatencyMs || "" }}', '')::int, (SELECT value::int FROM app_secrets WHERE key='ai_eval_max_latency_ms' LIMIT 1), 30000) AS max_latency_ms,
  dv.extraction_method, dv.ocr_quality_grade, dv.ocr_status, ds.sheet_name, dc.headers_json
FROM ai_test_cases c
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT extraction_method, ocr_quality_grade, ocr_status
  FROM document_versions
  WHERE document_id = c.expected_document_id AND status = 'CURRENT'
  ORDER BY version_number DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
) dv ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sheet_name FROM document_sheets WHERE document_id = c.expected_document_id ORDER BY sheet_index LIMIT 1
) ds ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT headers_json FROM document_chunks WHERE document_id = c.expected_document_id AND chunk_kind = 'tabular' ORDER BY chunk_order LIMIT 1
) dc ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT v.id, d.code AS prompt_code, v.version_number, v.content_hash
  FROM ai_prompt_versions v
  JOIN ai_prompt_definitions d ON d.id = v.prompt_definition_id
  WHERE NULLIF('{{ String($json.promptVersionId || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') IS NOT NULL
    AND v.id = NULLIF('{{ String($json.promptVersionId || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '')::uuid
) pv ON true
WHERE c.id = '{{ $json.caseId }}'::uuid
LIMIT 1;
